g.text: Earnings rise steeply to the late 20s (mean Rs 307,994 at 25-29),
Source: PSLM 2019-20. Sample: earners aged 15-64, Balochistan urban (n = 486).
Points: individual earners, jittered horizontally by up to 0.4 years. Large markers: hhweight-weighted
mean earnings by 5-year age band, at the band midpoint. Hollow markers: thin bands (fewer than 30 earners).
